subject: Forward-looking design of durable validation receipt capture

authority_binding.rule: This is the authority record, not a passing validation target or an input to repair historical evidence.

claims_under_review: A future recorder must retain an ordered discovery vector and bind exactly one terminal outcome to every ID, including lifecycle and class skips.
A future receipt needs a declared and hashed terminal-label vocabulary, raw stream hashes, an explicit parser grammar, and summary reconciliation.
A future receipt needs source/tree/interpreter/environment binding, privacy-sensitive redaction, atomic write/retention, and failure/rollback semantics.
required_design_elements: one terminal outcome per ID including lifecycle and class skips
raw stream hashes and explicit parser grammar
forbidden: production code, tests, fixtures, controllers, .autopilot/plan.json, CI, unittest discovery, candidate execution, performance, promotion, main, remotes
reuse, relabeling, qualification, or composition of 41950b74bdec2b6e1c48ee7f5ef3ce947d0c8378 or d02c2d2
judge_gate: Only a distinct RCD Judge, after zero unresolved material design findings, may authorize the opening of a separate newly sealed native implementation-proposal DAG. No implementation follows from this opening or verdict.
